# wechat-viral-topic · 公众号选题专家

> Machine-readable index for AI agents: `AI-INDEX.json`. Human/agent guide: `SKILL.md`. Chinese first, English follows.

## What this is (EN)
Separates a real signal from a clickbait guess when choosing topics, and applies compliance red lines before any draft is written.

## 这是什么（中文）
选题时把「真信号」与「标题党猜测」分开，并在动笔前先过合规红线。给出候选选题的证据强度分级，而不是热度数字。

## When to use it (EN)
Use when picking a WeChat/公众号 topic, judging whether a hot item is worth writing, or checking a draft for compliance risk before publishing.

## 什么时候用它（中文）
为公众号选题、判断热点是否值得写、或发布前检查稿件合规风险时使用。

## Entrypoints / 入口命令
```bash
python tools/topicguard.py score --file candidates.md --out ./out --json
python tools/topicguard.py redline --file draft.md --json
python tests/run_golden.py
```

## Output (EN)
Topic candidates graded by evidence strength (signal / weak signal / guess), plus a red-line list naming the exact sentence that trips each rule.

## 输出（中文）
按证据强度分级的候选选题（真信号/弱信号/猜测），以及点名到具体句子的红线清单。

## Proof you can re-run / 可复跑的证据
- Golden set: 11 cases — `python tests/run_golden.py` prints a pass count and exits 0.
- Differentiator: title overreach detection
- Zero dependencies, offline, no credentials. Standard library only.
